These event class definitions are copied from `ocsf/ocsf-schema` tag `1.4.0`
(commit `6109cc5e834c1adfee67dda6c9bcfa5e37f79012`), under the included
Apache-2.0 license. The router currently emits Account Change (3001), Authentication (3002), API
Activity (6003), and Detection Finding (2004); their pinned class definitions
and the shared base event are used by `TestOCSFSecurityEventsValidateAgainstPinned140Classes`.
